sources.note: Nothing. Section 6(b) (p. 3) gives the only evidence for the language: 'A wordlist comparison (Woodward 1991) showed very low lexical similarity <20% with both the original and new varieties of Costa Rican Sign Language (LESCO) and with another indigenous sign language (Bribri Sign Language).' Sole source cited is Woodward 1991.
